Hi Ellen —

Great to meet you on the call yesterday. As discussed, were running a short "Training Lab Sprint" series next week to walk your implementation team through the reference deployment, common integration patterns, and the failure-mode troubleshooting checklist. The goal is pragmatic: get a first successful inference pipeline deployed in your dev environment and hand off a living runbook.

Proposed cadence:
- Tue 9:00–10:30 PT: Lab session #1 (deployment + auth + sample prompts)
- Wed 9:00–10:00 PT: Deep-dive #2 (batching, caching, cost knobs)
- Thu 9:00–10:00 PT: Q&A + live debugging (office-hours style)

I've attached the implementation checklist and a zipped set of lab exercises. We'll record every session and post a short edited walkthrough. Can you confirm the primary attendees from your side and whether procurement or security should be cc'd on the invites?

If that cadence works, I'll send calendar invites and create a shared Drive folder for recordings and the runbook.

Thanks,
